statement: At pinned host sources, SDL's direct 28de:1302 Triton HIDAPI selection has no interface-number gate (429-451) and an active joystick periodically sends a single-setting lizard disable every 3 seconds (127-144,494-499); kernel IBEX registration sets its own lizard policy (1372-1406), and unlike 2015 input devices, IBEX evdev open/close does not toggle lizard (909-946). Thus application and kernel command policies differ even when each source path is valid. Which settings persist with both open, and actual Steam client writes: No evidence. This is source-only software behavior, not a live contention test.

applicability.revision: Linux v7.2 versus v7.3-rc1; SDL pinned at 6defbc0; no physical revision measured
applicability.scope: Direct wired 28de:1302 source-consumer only; tests proposed in docs/steam-consumer-contention.md, not run
